title: dactylorhiza longifolia
intro: Dactylorhiza longifolia, commonly known as the Autumn Lady's Tresses, is a species of orchid native to Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza longifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to contribute to its potential therapeutic uses in treating cardiovascular diseases and other inflammatory conditions.
